purpose: Coarse independent localization check for the supplied positive magnetic-sheet images
annotation_method: Visual axis-aligned boxes marked from the original 640x480 inputs before inspecting any expanded-scale predictions; approximately +/-3 pixels, not pixel-accurate masks
box_semantics: Visible complete outer object extent, xywh, original pixels. Internal hole is inside the box. All seven originals contain exactly one visible target.
limitations: Small positive-only local set; M01 is the embedded SMD source image and must be reported separately. These boxes support coarse localization/recall checks, not defect accuracy, calibrated confidence, exact pose/scale truth, false-positive probability or industrial deployment accuracy.
matching_rule: A prediction uses the transformed L0 outer-point axis extent, not the rotated rectangular training ROI. One-to-one IoU >= 0.5; unmatched spatial detections are FP. Report source and non-source separately.
